lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 8 distinct white vertical lines are visible. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, appearing as high-contrast vertical stripes against the dark grey-brown coat.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is a short segment terminating in the upper third of the torso. The two most posterior lines are fragmented into dashed segments and discrete spots.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5-6 distinct white spots is visible on the upper hind limb and posterior haunch area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower posterior haunch are aligned horizontally, mimicking the trajectory of the lateral stripes.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral, curving upward and outward from the frontal bone before twisting medially and posteriorly toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 15-20% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; white spots on lower cheeks; long dark ventral fringe; bright orange-tan lower limbs below the carpal and tarsal joints.
